children: Campbell's entered into an amendment to its $1.85 billion five-year credit agreement, effective Sep 16, 2026, extending the maturity from Apr 16, 2030 to Apr 16, 2031. JPMorgan Chase Bank serves as administrative agent alongside a syndicate of lenders. All other terms remain in effect, preserving the company's access to revolving liquidity for general corporate purposes.
: Amendment extending maturity of $1.85 billion revolving credit facility
: JPMorgan Chase Bank, as administrative agent, and other lenders
: Extend revolving credit maturity and maintain liquidity
